content: fclones (README + dedupe.rs): separate group vs remove/link/move/dedupe(reflink) commands consuming a report; --priority newest/oldest/etc, --keep-path/--keep-name never-remove patterns, --path/--name restrict removal, -n keep N replicas, --isolate cross-tree only, --dry-run prints shell commands; before acting drops files whose size changed and skips the entire group if any file mtime is newer than the report timestamp; link replace uses rename-to-temp, link, remove temp; optional persistent hash cache; JSON/CSV/fdupes outputs.
